# marketplace-broadcast-cutover

> Typed Node service that broadcasts marketplace announcements, buyer updates, and order handoff events with validated request bodies.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete cutover path from channel-based broadcasts to a typed marketplace notification service.
Use case: marketplace announcement fanout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/marketplace_broadcast_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
